Phiên bản runtime: `0.1.0` · namespace `simvehicleapp::rt` · C++17 · ADR-0021/0022.

Code trong `app/src/generated/` khai báo mỗi workflow bằng `rt::Workflow` (một câu lệnh cho mỗi trigger/node của IR);
runtime thực thi chúng trên một strand với đúng ngữ nghĩa của simulator (ADR-0017 Notes). Code của bạn đặt trong

## `simvehicleapp/rt/Runtime.hpp` — Khai báo workflow (code sinh ra dùng), app, trace

- `namespace simvehicleapp::rt`
  SimVehicleApp runtime for C++ vehicle apps (ADR-0021, execution semantics ADR-0012 + ADR-0017 Notes, executable spec = conformance C01…C38 and the golden traces). Generated code declares each workflow with a `Workflow` builder — one statement per IR trigger and node, expressions as typed lambdas — and the runtime executes it on one strand. All timing, concurrency policies, cancellation and tracing live here once instead of in every generated file.
- `struct Node`
  IR identity of a trigger or node: `nK` and the block it came from (trace + source map).
- `using Next = std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::string>>`
  Output handle → next node id; "" ends the run (IR `next`, ADR-0014).
- `using Outputs = std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::string>>`
  Output name → type of a trigger (trace `trigger` data).
- `class Ctx`
  Evaluation context of an expression: the current run (if any) and the app state.
- `template <class T> T out(const char* node, const char* output) const`
  Output `output` of trigger/node `node` in this run; missing ⇒ `no_value` (ADR-0017 Notes §14).
- `template <class T> T signal(const SignalRef& s) const`
  Latest value of a signal; none yet ⇒ `no_value`.
- `template <class T> T state(const StateRef& v) const`
  Current value of a workflow variable.
- `int64_t nowMs() const`
  `now_ms`: milliseconds of the app clock.
- `template <class F> Expr expr(F f)`
  Wraps a typed lambda `T(Ctx&)` as an `Expr`.
- `struct Concurrency`
  Concurrency policy of a trigger (ADR-0012 §4; IR `concurrency`, default parallel/4).
- `struct TraceRecord`
  One trace event (TraceEvent v1 without `runId`/`seq`, which the sink adds).
- `class ITraceSink`
  Receives trace events and logs (stdout `SVTRACE` lines in a real app, a list in tests).
- `class StdoutTraceSink final : public ITraceSink`
  `SVTRACE {json}` lines on stdout (ADR-0021 §7, contracts trace-event `runtimeLine`).
- `static TraceLevel levelFromEnv(TraceLevel fallback = TraceLevel::Node)`
  Level from env `SV_TRACE_LEVEL` (`off`, `trigger`, `node`), else `fallback`.
- `class Workflow`
  Builder of one workflow (one generated class); every call mirrors one IR trigger or node.
- `SignalRef signal(const std::string& id, const std::string& path, const std::string& type)`
  A VSS signal of the workflow (IR `signals[]`): id, path, VSS datatype.
- `TopicRef topic(const std::string& id, const std::string& topic)`
  An MQTT topic of the workflow (IR `topics[]`).
- `StateRef state(const std::string& id, const std::string& type, const Value& initial)`
  A workflow variable (IR `state[]`) shared by all runs of the app, with its initial value (JSON).
- `void onAppStart(Node n, Concurrency c, Outputs outputs, const std::string& entry)`
  `event.app_start`: one run when the app starts.
- `void onSignalChanged(Node n, const SignalRef& s, Change mode, std::optional<Value> threshold, int64_t debounceMs, Concurrency c, Outputs outputs, const std::string& entry)`
  `event.signal_changed`: a run per change of `s` matching `mode` (vs `threshold`), after `debounceMs`.
- `void onTimer(Node n, int64_t intervalMs, int64_t initialDelayMs, Concurrency c, Outputs outputs, const std::string& entry)`
  `event.timer`: ticks every `intervalMs` from `initialDelayMs` (ticks skipped by the policy still count).
- `void onCondition(Node n, Cond condition, int64_t debounceMs, Concurrency c, Outputs outputs, const std::string& entry)`
  `event.condition`: a run when `condition` becomes true (rising edge), held `debounceMs`.
- `void onMqtt(Node n, const TopicRef& t, bool jsonPayload, Concurrency c, Outputs outputs, const std::string& entry)`
  `event.mqtt_message`: a run per message on `t` (`+`/`#` filters); JSON payloads are parsed.
- `void read(Node n, const SignalRef& s, bool fresh, Next next)`
  `vehicle.read`/`read_attribute`: latest value (`fresh` asks the vehicle) ⇒ outputs `value`, `timestamp`.
- `void write(Node n, const SignalRef& s, Expr value, bool awaitAck, OnError onError, Next next)`
  `vehicle.write`: sets the actuator target; `awaitAck` waits for the databroker; errors take `error`/`onError`.
- `void branch(Node n, Cond condition, Next next)`
  `control.branch`: `then` or `else`.
- `void switchOn(Node n, Expr value, std::vector<Expr> cases, Next next)`
  `control.switch`: the first `case_i` equal to `value`, else `default`.
- `void wait(Node n, int64_t durationMs, Next next)`
  `control.wait`: continues after `durationMs` (cancelled with the run).
- `void waitUntil(Node n, Cond condition, int64_t timeoutMs, Next next)`
  `control.wait_until`: `ok` as soon as `condition` holds, `timeout` after `timeoutMs`.
- `void stableFor(Node n, Cond condition, int64_t durationMs, Next next)`
  `control.stable_for`: `stable` if `condition` holds for `durationMs`, `broken` when it stops holding.
- `void repeat(Node n, int64_t count, int64_t intervalMs, const std::string& body, Next next)`
  `control.repeat`: runs `body` `count` times (output `index`), `intervalMs` apart.
- `void whileLoop(Node n, Cond condition, int64_t maxIterations, int64_t intervalMs, const std::string& body, Next next)`
  `control.while`: runs `body` while `condition` holds; beyond `maxIterations` the run stops (`loop_guard`).
- `void parallel(Node n, std::vector<std::string> branches, Join join, Next next)`
  `control.parallel`: starts the branches; continues when all/any finished (`any` cancels the others) or at once (`none`).
- `void stop(Node n, StopScope scope, Next next)`
  `control.stop`: ends this run, every run of the workflow, or the app.
- `void stateGet(Node n, const StateRef& v, Next next)`
  `state.get`: output `value`.
- `void stateSet(Node n, const StateRef& v, Expr value, Next next)`
  `state.set`: assigns the variable (condition triggers and waits re-evaluate).
- `void counter(Node n, const StateRef& v, CounterOp op, int64_t step, Next next)`
  `state.counter`: increments/decrements by `step` (clamped to the type) or resets; output `value`.
- `void eval(Node n, const std::string& output, Expr value, Next next)`
  `logic.eval`: a pure block evaluated at this point of the run; `output` is its output name.
- `void inRange(Node n, Expr value, Expr low, Expr high, bool hysteresis, Next next)`
  `logic.in_range`: `low ≤ value ≤ high`, or a hysteresis switch; outputs `result`, `state`.
- `void log(Node n, std::optional<std::string> level, Expr message, Next next)`
  `comm.log`: a log line and a trace `value` event.
- `void publish(Node n, const TopicRef& t, Expr payload, Next next)`
  `comm.mqtt_publish`: publishes `payload` on `t`.
- `struct TriggerDef`
  Internal: IR declarations executed by the runtime.
- `std::string runId = "app"`
  `runId` of trace events (virtual runs; the orchestrator assigns it for live runs).
- `class Runtime`
  The app: workflows, signal cache, scheduler of runs. One per process (`AppBase`) or per test.
- `Workflow& workflow(const std::string& id, const std::string& name)`
  Declares a workflow (generated `bind`); workflows run in declaration order.
- `void start()`
  Reads the baselines, subscribes signals and topics, and posts the app start (app_start triggers, timers, condition baselines) on the strand.
- `void stopAll()`
  Cancels every run; the strand keeps running other events.

## `simvehicleapp/rt/Value.hpp` — Giá trị, định dạng, ép kiểu, so sánh (ngữ nghĩa IR_SPEC)

- `namespace simvehicleapp::rt`
  Values of the runtime (IR_SPEC "Semantics every backend implements", ADR-0015 Notes §7). Generated code works with native C++ types (bool, intN_t, float, double, std::string, std::vector<T>); `Value` is the dynamic form used for signal caches, run outputs and trace data. Integers keep their exact int64/uint64 value; `float` values are stored as the double of the float.
- `class EvalError : public std::runtime_error`
  Error of an expression or an I/O step; takes the step's `error` branch (ADR-0012 §6).
- `std::string formatDouble(double x)`
  Number formatted like ECMAScript `Number::toString` (shortest round trip).
- `std::string formatFloat(float x)`
  Shortest decimal that round-trips `x` as binary32 (IR_SPEC "Formatting in templates").
- `std::string stringify(const Value& v)`
  JSON text of `v` like `JSON.stringify` (numbers as `formatDouble`, no spaces).
- `std::string jsonString(const std::string& s)`
  JSON string literal of `s` (quotes and escapes), op `json.string`.
- `double roundHalfAway(double x)`
  Round half away from zero (ADR-0014 Notes §11).
- `Value toJson(const Value& v, const std::string& type)`
  Dynamic value ⇒ JSON for writes and trace: int64/uint64 as decimal strings (ADR-0018 §7).
- `Value fromJson(const Value& v, const std::string& type)`
  JSON/scenario value ⇒ the dynamic form of `type`.
- `std::string formatValue(const Value& v, const std::string& type)`
  Template formatting of a dynamic value of static type `type`.
- `double toNumber(const Value& v)`
  Numeric value (`Number(v)`): booleans 0/1, null 0.
- `Value castValue(const Value& v, const std::string& to, const std::string& from)`
  `type.cast` of a dynamic value to `to`; `from` is the static type of the value.
- `inline std::string format(bool v)`
  Template formatting of native values.
- `inline Value toValue(bool v)`
  Native value ⇒ dynamic value.
- `template <class T> struct From`
  Dynamic value ⇒ native value (the compiler checked the type; null is a missing value).
- `template <class T> T castInt(double x)`
  Integer bounds as doubles/ints for `cast`.
- `template <class To, class From_> To as(const From_& v)`
  `type.cast` / implicit conversion of native values (IR_SPEC Operators `type.cast`).
- `template <class L, class R> int compareNum(L l, R r)`
  Comparisons: integers exactly (signed vs unsigned too), otherwise as doubles.
- `std::string formatAsFloat(double x)`
  Template formatting of a double whose static type is `float` (simulator `formatFloat32` on any number).
- `inline int64_t absInt(int64_t v)`
  Integer `abs` (the compiler proved the result fits int64).
- `inline int64_t clampInt(int64_t v, int64_t lo, int64_t hi)`
  Integer `clamp`: below `lo` ⇒ `lo`, else above `hi` ⇒ `hi` (simulator order when lo > hi).
- `double jsMin(std::initializer_list<double> xs)`
  `min`/`max`/`clamp` on doubles like ECMAScript `Math.min`/`Math.max` (NaN propagates).
- `double roundTo(double v, double digits)`
  `round(v, digits)`: half away from zero at `digits` decimals.
- `inline double scale(double v, double a, double b, double c, double d)`
  `scale(x, inMin, inMax, outMin, outMax)`.
- `template <class T, class I> T arrayIndex(const std::vector<T>& arr, I index)`
  Element `i` of `arr` (`array.at` with a default / `array.index`, ADR-0018 §4).

## `simvehicleapp/rt/Strand.hpp` — Vòng sự kiện một luồng, đồng hồ

- `class IClock`
  Milliseconds of the app clock: steady time for a real app, virtual time in tests.
- `class SteadyClock final : public IClock`
  Monotonic milliseconds since the app started.
- `int64_t epochMs()`
  Wall clock in epoch milliseconds (trace `ts` of live runs, ADR-0027).
- `class Strand`
  Single-threaded event loop (ADR-0021 §2): every callback of the SDK and every timer of the app runs here, one at a time, ordered by (due time, sequence). Events at the same instant run in the order they were posted — the same order as the simulator (ADR-0017 Notes §1). `post`/`postAt` are thread-safe; everything else is called on the strand.
- `Strand()`
  A strand on a virtual clock that only `advanceTo`/`runUntil` move (tests, conformance).
- `explicit Strand(const IClock& clock)`
  A strand on `clock` that `run` drives in real time.
- `TimerId post(std::function<void()> fn)`
  Runs `fn` at the current instant, after what is already due now.
- `TimerId postAt(int64_t atMs, std::function<void()> fn)`
  Runs `fn` at `atMs` (never before the current instant).
- `void cancel(TimerId id)`
  The callback never runs (no-op if it already ran).
- `bool runUntil(int64_t untilMs)`
  Virtual clock: runs every event due up to and including `untilMs`; returns false if stopped.
- `void run()`
  Real clock: runs events as they become due until `stop`.
- `uint64_t events() const`
  Number of events run so far.

## `simvehicleapp/rt/Access.hpp` — Truy cập xe / MQTT (adapter thay được)

- `class IVehicleAccess`
  The vehicle as the runtime sees it (ADR-0021 §3): the only place that talks to the Velocitas SDK (`VelocitasVehicleAccess`) or to a test double (`testing::MockVehicle`). Every callback must run on the runtime's strand (an implementation on SDK threads posts them).
- `virtual std::optional<Value> current(const std::string& path, const std::string& type) = 0`
  Current value before the app starts (the baseline of change triggers); may block.
- `virtual void subscribe(const std::string& path, const std::string& type, std::function<void(const Value&)> onValue) = 0`
  Every later value of `path` (one subscription per path, shared by all triggers).
- `virtual void get(const std::string& path, const std::string& type, std::function<void(std::optional<Value>, const std::string&)> done) = 0`
  Fresh read; `done(value, error)` — an empty error means success.
- `virtual std::string checkWrite(const std::string& path, const std::string& type, const Value& value)`
  Rejects a write before it is sent (allowed values / bounds known locally); "" = accepted.
- `virtual void set(const std::string& path, const std::string& type, const Value& value, std::function<void(const std::string&)> done) = 0`
  Sets the actuator target; `done(error)` acknowledges it (null `done`: fire and forget).
- `class IPubSub`
  MQTT as the runtime sees it (Velocitas pub/sub client or `testing::MockPubSub`).
- `using Handler = std::function<void(const std::string& topic, const std::string& payload, const std::string* onlyFilter)>`
  A message: `onlyFilter` is the subscription it came through when the client cannot tell the topic (Velocitas SDK); null means "deliver to every trigger whose filter matches `topic`".
- `bool topicMatches(const std::string& filter, const std::string& topic)`
  MQTT topic filter match (`+` one level, `#` the rest).

## `simvehicleapp/rt/Testing.hpp` — Mock vehicle/MQTT, chạy scenario, kiểm kỳ vọng

- `namespace simvehicleapp::rt::testing`
  Test doubles of the runtime (ADR-0021 §9, ADR-0042 P1): a vehicle and an MQTT broker on a virtual clock, and a scenario player — the same model as the simulator, so a workflow run on them must produce the golden trace exactly.
- `struct Bounds`
  Bounds of a written signal (catalog min/max/allowed), checked like the simulator's `model`.
- `class MockVehicle final : public IVehicleAccess`
  Vehicle on the virtual clock: writes set the target only (ADR-0017 Notes §3).
- `void inject(const std::string& path, const Value& value)`
  The vehicle reports a new value (scenario input).
- `class MockPubSub final : public IPubSub`
  Broker on the virtual clock: publishes are delivered back to the app at once (loopback).
- `class RecordingSink final : public ITraceSink`
  Keeps every trace event and log line.
- `struct ScenarioResult`
  Outcome of a scenario run, in the simulator's JSON shapes.
- `ScenarioResult runScenario(const std::function<void(Runtime&)>& bind, const Value& scenario, const std::string& runId = "sim", const std::map<std::string, Bounds>& bounds =`
  Runs a scenario (contracts `scenario` v1 as JSON) against the workflows `bind` declares: inputs are scheduled before the app starts (simulator order), the clock runs to `until`.
- `std::vector<std::string> checkExpectations(const ScenarioResult& result, const Value& expect)`
  `expect` of a scenario: exact writes, ordered partial trace matchers; returns the mismatches.

## `simvehicleapp/rt/Velocitas.hpp` — Adapter Velocitas SDK 0.7.1 và host `AppBase` (chỉ trong project)

- `namespace simvehicleapp::rt`
  The only part of the runtime that uses the Velocitas SDK (ADR-0021 §3–4): signals go through `IVehicleDataBrokerClient` by path, MQTT through `IPubSubClient`; every SDK callback is posted to the strand, nothing awaits on it.
- `class AppBase : public velocitas::VehicleApp`
  Host of a generated app (`SimVehicleApp : AppBase`): connects to the databroker ("vehicledatabroker") and MQTT like the template's SampleApp, then runs the workflows on a strand thread. Trace goes to stdout (`SVTRACE`, level from `SV_TRACE_LEVEL`).
- `explicit AppBase(const std::string& appName, TraceLevel defaultLevel = TraceLevel::Node)`
  `defaultLevel`: trace level of the project; env `SV_TRACE_LEVEL` overrides it.
- `virtual void bindWorkflows(Runtime& rt) = 0`
  Declares the workflows (generated).
- `virtual void onAppStart()`
  User hooks (`app/src/user/UserHooks.*`), called around the workflows.
